title: Elon Musk creates his own cringe name for AI music
description: Elon Musk claims artificial intelligence has “good taste” as he defended AI music and music videos after they were branded “slopcore” by critics. Appearing via video link at the X Takeover event held at Giga Texas on Saturday, the Tesla and SpaceX chief said that AI music is “the fastest growing genre” and should be instead known as “awesomecore.” Musk said: “the AI music is really good and the music videos are amazing. It just shows taste. And you're like, ‘Wow, AI can do good taste? That's pretty wild’."
